summary: The payment container has stopped. Its last log line is at 20:42:00, and its span rate is now 0. Checkout calls PaymentService/Charge and gets 'name resolver error: produced zero addresses', so every PlaceOrder fails with a 500. That 500 is passed up through frontend, frontend-proxy and the load-generator, and it triggered the CheckoutFailing and ServiceErrors alerts. Checkout is only suffering from this. I did not see why payment stopped, because the logs and metrics don't show it.

evidence.finding: CheckoutFailing and ServiceErrors (checkout failing more than 5% of requests) are firing since 20:45:57.
Errors appear only in checkout, frontend, frontend-proxy and load-generator, plus a small rate in flagd. No error spans from payment or other backends.

The deepest error span is checkout -> oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge, which took 0 ms with 'name resolver error: produced zero addresses'. Cart, product-catalog, currency and shipping calls in the same trace all succeeded.
The newest payment log is at 20:42:00 ('Transaction complete.'). There are no logs after that and no error logs, which is consistent with the container stopping.

suggested_fix: For a human to approve: on the Docker host, run `docker compose ps payment` and `docker logs --tail 100 payment` to see why it stopped (for example an exit code or OOM kill). Then restart it with `docker compose up -d payment`. After that, check that the payment span rate is above 0 and that checkout errors clear. Also confirm payment is on the same compose network as checkout.
